speaker: Doctor
text:
I am Dr. Agent. You've presented with generalized fatigue, severe itching, and abnormal liver function tests; to narrow this down, have you noticed any changes in your urine color, such as it appearing dark or tea-colored?

REQUEST TEST: Liver_Function_Panel (ALT, AST, Alk Phos, Bilirubin, Albumin, INR)
REQUEST TEST: CBC and Peripheral_Smear

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Liver_Function_Panel: ALT 78 U/L, AST 75 U/L, Alkaline_Phosphatase 460 U/L, Bilirubin_Total 1.5 mg/dL, Bilirubin_Direct 0.9 mg/dL; CBC: Hemoglobin 11.5 g/dL, Leukocyte_Count 7500/mm3, Platelet_Count 280,000/mm3.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The labs show elevated alkaline phosphatase with mild transaminitis; have you noticed pale, clay-colored stools or yellowing of your skin or eyes?

REQUEST TEST: Urine_Bilirubin_and_Urobilinogen
REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_Ultrasound

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Urine_Bilirubin: Positive; Urobilinogen: Normal; Abdominal_Ultrasound: Thickening of the bile ducts and focal bile duct dilatation.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The ultrasound showing bile duct thickening and dilatation, combined with high Alkaline Phosphatase and dark urine, strongly suggests a blockage in the bile ducts; have you recently experienced any fever, right upper quadrant pain, or unintentional weight loss?

REQUEST TEST: CT_Abdomen_with_contrast
REQUEST IMAGES: MRCP

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: CT_Abdomen_with_contrast: Normal liver parenchyma, patent main portal vein, no evidence of mass or obstruction in the biliary tree; MRCP: No biliary ductal dilation or strictures identified; intrahepatic and extrahepatic bile ducts are normal in caliber and course.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The imaging rules out extrahepatic obstruction, yet your labs show significantly elevated alkaline phosphatase and direct bilirubin with normal transaminases; have you noticed any rashes, joint pain, or other systemic symptoms like night sweats?

REQUEST TEST: ESR and CRP
REQUEST TEST: Autoimmune_Panel (ANA, AMA, ANA-M2, ASMA)
REQUEST TEST: IgG4_level

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: ESR: 28 mm/hr; CRP: 1.2 mg/dL; Autoimmune_Panel: ANA Negative, AMA Negative, ASMA Negative; IgG4_level: 285 mg/dL

speaker: Doctor
text:
The inflammatory markers are mildly elevated, but your autoimmune panel is negative for primary biliary cholangitis and autoimmune hepatitis, though your IgG4 level is borderline high; given the isolated cholestatic pattern and normal imaging, do you have any history of other autoimmune conditions or a known allergic reaction history?

REQUEST TEST: Serology for Celiac Disease (tTG-IgA)
REQUEST TEST: Serology for Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis (p-ANCA)

DIAGNOSIS READY: Cholepruritus (Pruritus secondary to cholestasis with non-obstructive etiology)
